newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Empire plunges to record low in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Empire plunges to record low in Manila.

text.p: Mass housing builder Empire East Land Holdings Inc fell by 1.7 pesos, or 32.67 percent, to a record low of 3.50 pesos in late Manila trade on concerns over the company's financial health, traders said.
Officials of the company were not immediately available for comment. Empire East employees said officials were in a meeting.
Empire East had briefly touched 3.20 pesos.
Its parent firm Megaworld Properties & Holdings Inc also lost 1.70 pesos to 3.60 pesos.
"There's panic selling on Empire East and Megaworld," said one broker who did not want to be identified.
Some 54.26 million shares of Empire East changed hands as of 11.22 a.m. local time (0322 GMT) and 5.38 million shares of Megaworld.
